Info

Builder component for application top menu cascades (File, Edit, View).

class scarajectory.infrastructure.gui.menu.menu_layout_builder.MenuLayoutBuilder[source]¶

Bases: object

Constructs and mounts the top application menu bar widget hierarchy.

It defines:

methods:
build_menu - Constructs File, Edit, View cascades and menu.
build_menu(root: Tk, menu_bar: IAppMenuBar, mutation: IPlanMutationService, history: ITrajectoryHistory, navigator: ICanvasViewNavigator) → None[source]¶

Constructs File, Edit, View cascades and sets root menu.

Parameters:

  • root – Application root Tk window.

  • menu_bar – IAppMenuBar interface instance.

  • mutation – IPlanMutationService domain mutation instance.

  • history – ITrajectoryHistory domain history instance.

  • navigator – ICanvasViewNavigator interface instance.

Exceptions:

None.
